expected_structural_delta: Farm adds one PHP queue/sizing helper plus existing shell adapter/tests; QA adds short native observation/apply and removes superseded general reader/cache/scope; no new service, ledger or owner.
minimum_design: Move existing general reader semantics and desired-target formula into existing Farm runtime using PHP curl_multi. Extend existing farm-capacity adapter with short native demand-observe and demand-apply actions. Farm scans before obtaining native owner observation; native apply rechecks policy digest, freshness and exact owners before sparse starts/idle withdrawal. No second broker, service or durable desired-state store. Qualify both releases first. Per host, install new Farm runtime first: missing demand-observe/apply capability fails closed for new scaling and preserves existing jobs. Install new QA provider through native lease next; it removes general queue reads, supplies short owner observation/apply, and preserves OS legacy scale. New Farm resumes automatically on its normal tick. Keep the other host serving. No automatic legacy-general fallback or dual scheduler.
outcome: CI Runner Farm owns OVH general build queue reads and desired sizing; one shared native resource broker preserves busy jobs, physical floors and OS legacy routing.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing Farm PHP runtime and native fleet lock
reuse_decisions.rationale: Queue scan and sizing move to the existing controller without a new service.

reuse_decisions.name: Shared broker and fenced owner lifecycle
reuse_decisions.rationale: Short observe/apply commands revalidate exact policy and owners; no second resource ledger.

reuse_decisions.name: General QA reader and HTTP cache
reuse_decisions.rationale: Port complete authenticated scope, pagination and cache protections into Farm; remove general reader from QA while retaining OS/QA queue primitives.
